# tanstack-hide

> Chrome extension that hides the floating TanStack Devtools trigger button, globally or per site, with a status dot on the toolbar icon. The devtools panel still opens with its hotkey.

tanstack-hide is open source (khanakia/tanstack-hide, MIT). It runs entirely in the browser and makes no network requests; settings are stored with Chrome sync in the user's own profile. It works with apps that mount the unified TanStack Devtools (`@tanstack/devtools`, `@tanstack/react-devtools`), as used by TanStack Router, TanStack Query and TanStack Start projects. It is not affiliated with TanStack.

## Docs
- [README](https://github.com/khanakia/tanstack-hide/blob/main/README.md): what it does, install, every popup control, use cases, troubleshooting, FAQ
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/khanakia/tanstack-hide/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): release history
- [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/khanakia/tanstack-hide/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): development setup and tests

## Install
- Download tanstack-hide-vX.Y.Z.zip from https://github.com/khanakia/tanstack-hide/releases/latest, unzip it, open chrome://extensions, enable Developer mode, click "Load unpacked" and select the unzipped tanstack-hide folder (or clone the repo and select it). The .crx in each release installs by drag-and-drop on Linux only; Chrome on Windows and macOS accepts only Web Store .crx files.
